sources.entry: rembg - A tool to remove image backgrounds.

summary.one_liner: rembg is a Python tool that removes image backgrounds, usable as a CLI, Python library, HTTP server, or Docker container.
summary.what_it_does: rembg removes the background from images and outputs a cutout with transparency or a mask. It exposes a CLI with subcommands for single files (i), folders with optional watch mode (p), an HTTP server (s), raw RGB24 streams from stdin such as FFmpeg output (b), model download (d), and model migration (m). The Python API provides remove() accepting bytes, PIL images, or NumPy arrays, plus new_session() for reusing a model across a batch. It supports many local ONNX models (u2net family, isnet, sam, several birefnet variants, bria-rmbg as default) that download on first use, and two cloud API backends (withoutbg and atlascloud). Edge handling is selectable: default naive, -dc color decontamination, -a alpha matting, or -vm ViTMatte.
use_cases: batch remove backgrounds from a folder of images
run a background removal web service or API
cut out hair and fine detail from portraits
strip backgrounds from video frames via FFmpeg
extract a foreground mask from an image
notable: Choice of edge modes: naive, color decontamination (-dc), alpha matting (-a), and ViTMatte (-vm), with guidance on when to use each
Wide model catalog including SAM with point prompts, birefnet variants for portraits and DIS, and a 1 GB default bria-rmbg model
RGB24 stdin mode (rembg b) designed to pipe FFmpeg video frames
Models stored under ~/.rembg with migration command from legacy ~/.u2net
Optional cloud backends (withoutbg, atlascloud) that send images to third-party servers
caveats: Default model bria-rmbg is about 1.02 GB and slower than u2net; its RMBG-2.0 weights need a paid BRIA license for commercial use
NVIDIA GPU acceleration may need onnxruntime-gpu, CUDA and cudnn-devel; the CUDA Docker image is about 11 GB and must be built locally
Cloud backends upload images to external servers with a 20 MB limit; atlascloud jobs can take over a minute per image
Model weights carry their own licenses separate from rembg's MIT license
